answer: We formalize a mechanism integrating dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect punishment matrices to protect the protocol summit. This capital barrier mandates substantial staking collateral that entangles malicious actors like a dense vine, proving the expected utility of identity multiplication remains strictly negative. Since slashing penalties ensure sub-zero payoff for all Sybil-based attempts, even a willow-like strategic maneuver by an adversary fails to prevent the convergence of the unique, robust Nash equilibrium.
